headline: Q1 organic growth of 1% (-6% reported) as Middle East conflict cost ~1 pt; US +3% and Asia ex-Japan +7%.
key_messages: Fashion & Leather Goods -2% organic; US and China demand improving, Middle East hit by conflict.
Wines & Spirits +5% organic on champagne in Europe and Lunar New Year timing for cognac.
Selective Retailing +4% organic; Sephora gained share in all regions. Watches & Jewelry +7%.
Regions: US +3%, Asia ex-Japan +7%, Europe and Japan -3%; FX cut reported growth by ~7 pts.

consumer.big_ticket: Resilient US luxury spending; Middle East conflict disrupted travel and regional sales.

macro_read: US luxury demand was modestly positive in early 2026, a resilient but not booming read on high-income spending.
notes: LVMH is listed in Paris and reports in euros. It does not file with the SEC, so this card is refreshed on request, not automatically.
Share move on 2026-04-14 (first session after the after-close release) not found.
